name: cli_onboarding
note: Long goal written as a to-do list — the shape users actually type. The provider still returns outcome-phrased milestones (three, with one fan-in), and the fallback proves that even an imperative-list goal produces a constructible deterministic plan.

mission.goal: Fix onboarding for the CLI, update the getting-started guide, and add a first-run check. Right now a new user installs the tool, runs it, and gets a stack trace because no project has been initialised — and the guide does not mention that step at all. Support sees the same three questions every week: why the first command fails, where the config file lives, and how to tell whether the install worked. Over the next quarter a first run should either work or explain itself, and the guide should match what the tool actually does.

milestones.goal: a first run either works or explains exactly what is missing
milestones.rationale: A stack trace on first run is the single biggest drop-off.
